         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.github.spoonlabs</groupId>
    <artifactId>flacoco</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.6-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>flacoco</name>
    <description>Fault Localization for Java based on Jacoco</description>
    <url>https://github.com/SpoonLabs/flacoco</url>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>MIT License</name>
            <url>http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php</url>
        </license>

        </developer>
    </developers>

    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:git://github.com/SpoonLabs/flacoco.git</connection>
        <developerConnection>scm:git:ssh://github.com:SpoonLabs/flacoco.git</developerConnection>
        <url>http://github.com/SpoonLabs/flacoco/tree/master</url>
    </scm>

    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>

    <repositories>
        <repository>
            <id>sonatype</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
            <snapshots />
        </repository>
    </repositories>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- dependencies for the junit classpah -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>junit</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
            <version>4.13.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId>
            <version>5.3.2</version>
        </dependency>

            <version>5.3.2</version>
        </dependency>

            <version>1.3.2</version>

            <artifactId>junit-platform-engine</artifactId>

            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-params</artifactId>
            <version>5.3.2</version>

            <groupId>eu.stamp-project</groupId>
            <artifactId>test-runner</artifactId>
            <version>4.11</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>fr.inria.gforge.spoon</groupId>
            <artifactId>spoon-core</artifactId>
            <version>9.2.0-beta-1</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>log4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-core</artifactId>
            <version>2.19.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-jcl</artifactId>
            <version>2.19.0</version>

The upgrade from `maven-surefire-common` `3.0.0-M5` to `3.0.0-M7` removed the static method `TestListResolver.getWildcard()`, causing 5 compilation errors across 3 files.

1. **SourceFolderFinder.java** (line 25)

3. **TestFrameworkStrategy.java** (lines 92, 97)

### Fix Applied

Replaced all occurrences of:
```java
TestListResolver.getWildcard()
```

With:
```java
TestListResolver.getEmptyTestListResolver()
```

The `getEmptyTestListResolver()` method is the replacement in version 3.0.0-M7 that returns a resolver with no specific patterns, effectively acting as a wildcard (matching all tests).

`mvn compile` now succeeds with only 2 warnings about unchecked operations (unrelated to this issue).
